questions.question: Which of the following best describes Leonardo da Vinciâs early education?
options: He received a basic and informal education in writing, reading, and mathematics, possibly because his artistic talents were recognized early.
He attended a formal university in Florence to study law, following his father's wishes.

answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Leonardo only received a basic and informal education in (vernacular) writing, reading, and mathematics, possibly because his artistic talents were recognized early, so his family decided to focus their attention there.
Incorrect. The article does not mention Leonardo attending a university; it notes his basic informal education.
Incorrect. The article says his education was basic and informal, not exclusively art by his father.
Incorrect. While his birth was illegitimate, the article mentions he did receive some education, not that he was largely self-taught.

questions.question: Which of the following is mentioned as a reason Leonardoâs early childhood is largely unknown?
